betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Device Info Terminal is your machine ledger.

Right-click any working GT machine to bind it; right-click air to open the ledger. Rows show tri-state (Running/Idle/Stopped), instant EU/t, a §160-point rolling average§r, position and the current recipe. Sort by any of five columns; the notation mode toggles like the monitors.

The row's sparkle button teleports you to the machine for §1XP levels§r, Ctrl+click unbinds remotely, and shift+right-click air runs a scan of team machines in your current dimension with a §1per-second 5s countdown§r (loaded chunks only). Placing a machine while carrying the terminal auto-binds it too.
